BarrileteCósmico

A kite that flies to Mars. It watches an astronaut's health, so the crew can decide on board.Un barrilete que vuela a Marte. Vigila la salud de un astronauta para que la tripulación decida a bordo.

Scroll to follow the kiteBajá para seguir al barrilete

Radiation dose (example)Dosis de radiación (ejemplo)
Radio delayDemora de radio 0 min

Far from homeLejos de casa

Mars can be up to 20 minutes away by radio. Help cannot answer right away.Marte puede estar a 20 minutos por radio. La ayuda no puede responder enseguida.

Five hazardsCinco riesgos

Radiation, isolation, distance, gravity and a closed environment. The tail has one letter for each: R I D G E.Radiación, aislamiento, distancia, gravedad y un ambiente cerrado. La cola tiene una letra de cada uno: R I D G E.

Solar stormTormenta solar

Particles are coming. The wristband turns red and says: shelter now.Vienen partículas. La pulsera se pone roja y avisa: refugio ya.

Decide on boardDecidir a bordo

In the shelter the dose drops. The astronaut acts first, without waiting for Earth.En el refugio baja la dosis. El astronauta actúa primero, sin esperar a la Tierra.

Earth finds out laterLa Tierra se entera después

The alert reaches Earth 20 minutes later. The answer takes another 20 to come back.La alerta llega a la Tierra 20 minutos después. La respuesta tarda otros 20 en volver.

Now you fly it.Ahora lo volás vos.

Press a scenario in the dark blue bar. Watch what the astronaut gets, then what Earth gets later.Tocá un escenario en la barra azul oscura. Mirá lo que recibe el astronauta y, más tarde, lo que recibe la Tierra.

              ASTRONAUT HEALTH MONITOR

              ARCHITECTURE · WHERE EVERYTHING LIVES

              — SPACECRAFT —
              SENSORS & DEVICESVitals from wearable sensors and medical devices
              →
              ONBOARD DATA BUSInternal channel that delivers each reading to the database and to the downlink agent
              →
              SQLITEvitals.db on board: every reading is stored, with a “sent” flag
              →
              ASTRONAUT UITraffic light, guidance and routine, with no help from Earth
              — DEEP-SPACE LINK · DELAY 3–22 MIN ONE WAY (MARS) · BLACKOUTS —
              DOWNLINK AGENTStore-and-forward: sends from SQLite, resends the backlog after a blackout
              →
              MISSION CONTROLSees the past: what the ship sent one delay ago. Sends advice that also takes one delay to arrive.
